capabilities: Aggregate open tasks carrying a chosen tag from the whole vault
Group tasks into three due-date horizons (in progress, upcoming, later)
Reorder tasks by drag-and-drop with the order persisting across refreshes
Complete tasks in their source notes, including recurring task rollover
Jump from a task to its source note at the right line
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; the README says to install via BRAT or by copying files manually, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted a single list that combines automatic aggregation with manual ordering that survives refreshes, which plain query views cannot do.
problem: Query-based task views auto-aggregate but have fixed order, while Kanban boards allow dragging but don't auto-fill from the vault, so no view offers both.

relations.evidence: Recurring tasks (🔁, via the Tasks plugin) roll over to their next occurrence.
Query-based task views (Tasks, Dataview) auto-aggregate but are read-only in order.
Kanban boards let you drag cards but don't auto-fill from your vault.

summary: Task view that gathers tagged open tasks from across the vault into a due-date-grouped list with persistent drag-and-drop ordering.
